RULE: 'The execution of the READ statement causes the value of the I-O status in the file connector referenced by file-name-1 to be updated as indicated in 9.1.13, I-O status.' MECHANISM HALF -- CONFORMS. FileConnector.Status is the ONE assignment path (its setter also records EverAccessed and drops the 43 gate), and every READ terminal on all three organizations assigns before returning: SequentialConnector.Read (47/10/46/00/04/06/09), RelativeConnector.ReadSequential+ReadRandom, IndexedConnector.ReadSequential+ReadRandom. Both emitters call EmitStoreFileStatus in BOTH the success and the failure branch, so the FILE STATUS data item is written on every execution. VALUE HALF -- both known defects have landed: (a) PB336 fixed the absent-OPTIONAL 10/46 guard order; (b) PB329 supplied the missing 09 producer (9.1.13.2 item 7 / 14.9.30.4 GR16) together with the Annex A.1 item 115 determination the rule delegates to (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-115) -- FileStatusCode.LineRecordInvalidCharRead now exists and SequentialConnector.Read's line-sequential arm produces it. No 9.1.13 value a READ can require is left without a producer. kb/Work PB688 (2026-09-05): the 2002 copy of pb329_line_sequential_charset was deleted - ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL is a 2023 introduction, so no edition below 2023 can express that program; the 2023 copy carries the evidence.
